origin: Redacted model-visible regression extracted from immutable development trace; branch links reconnected after removing non-tool entries

findings.claim: core.normalize_key changed from normalize_key(key) to normalize_key(key, mode) with no default for mode. The untouched caller cache.lookup still calls it with a single argument (cache.py line 4: CACHE[normalize_key(key)]), so every lookup now raises TypeError: normalize_key() missing 1 required positional argument: 'mode'.
findings.impact: Runtime TypeError on all cache lookups, breaking the cache module's functionality at call time.
findings.title: normalize_key now requires a 'mode' argument, breaking untouched caller cache.lookup
findings.trigger: Calling cache.lookup('ready') (or any key) after this change.
